name: Dropdown
summary: A trigger button that reveals a floating list of actions — an overflow or actions menu.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-dropdown> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; a trigger button reveals a floating list from the `items` JSON array. Open/close animates via the shared motion tokens on a PERSISTENT panel (a class toggles — the subtree is never rebuilt on open), the caret rotates, and it closes on outside-click or Escape. The caret is the DS glyph via <aha-icon>. Emits a composed `select` event.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for `select`; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

whenToUse.when: a set of actions or options should sit behind a trigger to save space
the same list belongs inline, always visible — not behind a trigger
the control picks a single value for a form field, not fires an action

opinion.note: A dropdown holds actions or navigation, not form values — use Select for a field. Keep the item list short; the panel closes on outside-click and Escape. Put a Menu inside it rather than reinventing the row styling.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 has no measured Dropdown cell; spec derived from the token layer (white trigger, border #E3E3E3, border-hover, bg-elevated panel, radius-default 8) + AntD Dropdown conventions (caret trigger, floating panel, outside-click close). Motion bound to the shared motion tokens on a persistent panel; caret glyph from the DS icon library.
